mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_ID AS userId, A.USER_NAME AS userName, A.SEX AS sex, A.height AS height, DATE_FORMAT(A.birthday, '%y년') AS birthday, A.job_division AS jobDivision, B.PASS_FLAG AS passFlag, A.RESIDENCE AS residence, B.CHANCE AS chance, A.phone_number AS phoneNumber FROM USER_TABLE A INNER JOIN USER_MANAGE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID ORDER BY USER_NAME ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(A.EPISODE, '%y년 %m월 %d일 %p %h시') AS episode, B.USER_ID AS userId, A.LOCATION AS location , C.USER_NAME AS userName, C.SEX AS sex, DATE_FORMAT(C.birthday, '%y년') AS birthday, C.JOB_DIVISION AS jobDivision FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM PARTICIPANT_USER) B ON A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM USER_TABLE) C ON B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID ORDER BY A.EPISODE DESC , C.SEX ASC, C.USER_NAME ASC

SELECT A.USER_ID userId, B.PICK pick, B.USER_ID pickedUserId, DATE_FORMAT(A.EPISODE, '%y년 %m월 %d일 %p %h시') AS episode, DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATETIME, '%y년 %m월 %d일 %p %h시') createtime FROM PARTICIPANT_USER A LEFT OUTER JOIN MATCHING B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE ORDER BY A.EPISODE DESC
select episode,complete_flag completeFlag, headCount, location FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_MANAGE A SET A.CHANCE = A.CHANCE + 1 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_MANAGE A SET A.CHANCE = A.CHANCE - 1 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

UPDATE USER_MANAGE
PASS_FLAG = 'Y'
PASS_FLAG = 'N'
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE WHERE EPISODE = REPLACE(#{episode}, 'T', ' ')
DELETE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE EPISODE = REPLACE(#{episode}, 'T', ' ')
